claim_boundary: This is an external transport test of a recovered source-fitted 75% profile. It is not a bitwise reconstruction of a model artifact the source audit failed to save, and it does not establish causality or universal Coherence Dynamics.
modeling: Recover the source final-fit models using the exact source data hashes, split, feature order, C values, and original source thresholds; serialize and hash preprocessing plus coefficients before external acquisition. No external fitting, feature selection, hyperparameter selection, threshold tuning, or calibration.
primary_metric: PR-AUC delta: frozen simple-plus-CD minus frozen simple
primary_question: Does a source-fitted Nebius 75%-horizon simple-plus-CD profile, recovered and cryptographically sealed before external acquisition, improve prediction of independently evaluated coding-task success over its paired simple profile on non-Nebius external trajectories?
